blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
Failure modes we design against, with the guard shipped for each:

items: Key fragility
Key fragility: root keys live in HSMs under dual control with ceremony logs; rotation is rehearsed, not documented; the guard is part of the first slice, not a hardening phase
Ledger worship
Ledger worship — a chain only helps where counterparties dispute truth; workflows that already trust one database stay on one database
On-chain PII
On-chain PII: personal data never touches the ledger; only salted hashes and pointers are anchored; the guard is part of the first slice, not a hardening phase
